name: CHRONO Scan
function: Detects observed timing structure (recurrence, cadence, clustering) from TemporalEvent streams without symbolic interpretation or Forecast influence.
constraints: Weak or insufficient signal yields nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE
Required source_family omitted, empty, or malformed yields nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE
Any event lacking a parseable timestamp yields timestamps_missing plus NOT_COMPUTABLE
Deterministic: identical ordered events + time_field + window_config yield identical outputs
canonical_statement: RUNE.CHRONO_SCAN (CHS) observes recurrence, cadence, and clustering from TemporalEvent streams and emits null-safe metrics with NOT_COMPUTABLE flags when signal is weak. It does not interpret symbols, recommend execution, assert causality, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: Given identical ordered events + identical time_field + identical window_config, outputs must be identical. No randomness.

inputs.name: window_config
inputs.type: { lookback_span: string | null; bucket_size: string | null }

outputs.name: observed
outputs.type: { cadence_interval: number | null; recurrence_strength: number | null; window_density: number | null; timing_volatility: number | null; cadence_stability: number | null; recurrence_pressure: number | null; not_computable_flags?: string[] }

outputs.name: provenance
outputs.type: { computation_path: string[]; source_family_trace?: string[]; source_ids?: string[]; confidence: number | null }
